## Competitor Price Monitor
Tracks competitor prices across stores, keeps the history, and alerts you when someone undercuts you.

Every morning it loads each competitor page in the Watchlist, extracts price and stock with simple selectors, and alerts on Slack when a price drops more than 5% or undercuts yours. Only monitor public pages, respect each site's terms and robots.txt, and keep the schedule gentle. Keep last_price updated (e.g. from a sheet) to detect drops.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/price-monitor-scraper
